reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness WebUI performance utility that adds toggleable rendering, loading, caching, and memory optimizations through source/runtime patches; human review is warranted because it can modify installed packages and invoke system-level cleanup affecting Edge processes.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 提供可开关的渲染、历史加载、缓存和内存优化，并配套官方包补丁管理与健康检测。
summaries.en: Provides toggleable rendering, history-loading, caching, and memory optimizations for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI, with package patch management and health checks.

capabilities: Applies source and runtime patches to DeepSeek Harness packages
Modifies installed web application bundles and allowlists
Provides browser WebUI performance optimizations with persistent settings
Can invoke host PowerShell memory cleanup for the application and Edge processes
Can clear all Edge renderer working sets and refresh the page after confirmation
Runs patch health checks and can automatically reapply a runtime allowlist patch
